     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	
     5	The Coding AI Leaderboard tracks the open-source repositories gaining the most GitHub stars each week. The data below covers the week of **April 9–15, 2026**, capturing a period of intense community activity around AI agent frameworks, Claude Code tooling, and developer productivity utilities. A total of roughly **48,000 new stars** were distributed across the top 20 entries alone.

    31	
    32	## Dominant Leader: hermes-agent
    33	
    34	NousResearch's **hermes-agent** claimed the number-one spot with **+9,715 stars** in a single week — nearly double the second-place entry. The repository provides an open-source agent framework built on the Hermes model family, and its explosive growth signals strong developer demand for fully open agent tooling that can rival proprietary alternatives.
    35	
    36	## The Claude Code Ecosystem Surge
    37	
    38	Five of the top 20 repositories are directly related to Anthropic's Claude Code product:
    39	
    40	- **claude-code-best-practice** (#9, +2,151) — curated best-practice guides
    41	- **everything-claude-code** (#10, +1,978) — comprehensive resource collection
    42	- **claude-mem** (#11, +1,828) — memory management plugin
    43	- **claw-code** (#15, +1,285) — alternative CLI wrapper
    44	- **openclaw** (#16, +1,268) — open-source Claude Code extension framework
    45	
    46	Together these five repos accumulated over **8,500 stars**, underscoring how quickly a third-party ecosystem is forming around Claude Code.
    47	
    48	## Other Notable Trends
    49	
    50	- **AI-assisted design** is gaining traction: VoltAgent's awesome-design-md (#5, +3,246) curates design resources in Markdown, while graphify (#7, +2,763) converts data into visual graphs using AI.
    51	- **Microsoft's markitdown** (#6, +3,048) continues its steady climb, converting documents to Markdown for LLM ingestion — a utility play that benefits the entire AI stack.
    52	- **New entry gstack** (#20, +1,012) by Garry Tan debuted on the leaderboard, focusing on a full-stack AI development toolkit.
    53	
    54	## Key Takeaways
    55	
    56	1. **Agent-first development is surging** — hermes-agent's nearly 10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry.
    57	2. **Claude Code's ecosystem is expanding fast** — 25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product.
    58	3. **Utility and infrastructure tools** like markitdown show that foundational open-source packages continue to attract sustained interest alongside flashier agent projects.
    59	
    60	*Data sourced from star-history.com, week of April 9–15, 2026.*

import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# Poster dimensions (portrait 1080x1920)
W, H = 1080, 1920

# Colors (dark mode)
BG = "#0d1117"          # deep charcoal / near-black
SURFACE = "#161b22"     # card/surface
SURFACE_LIGHT = "#1c2128"
BORDER = "#30363d"      # borders
TEXT_PRIMARY = "#e6edf3"
TEXT_SECONDARY = "#8b949e"
ACCENT_BLUE = "#58a6ff"
ACCENT_GREEN = "#3fb950"
ACCENT_AMBER = "#d29922"
ACCENT_PURPLE = "#a371f7"
ACCENT_RED = "#f85149"

# Font setup
font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
font_bold_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
font_mono_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"

def load_font(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

f_title = load_font(font_bold_path, 56)
f_subtitle = load_font(font_path, 26)
f_metric_val = load_font(font_bold_path, 42)
f_metric_label = load_font(font_path, 18)
f_section_title = load_font(font_bold_path, 28)
f_rank_num = load_font(font_bold_path, 22)
f_repo_name = load_font(font_bold_path, 22)
f_stars = load_font(font_mono_path, 20)
f_trend = load_font(font_path, 20)
f_tag = load_font(font_path, 16)
f_takeaway = load_font(font_path, 20)
f_footer = load_font(font_path, 16)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# Helper: text size

def text_size(text, font):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2]-bbox[0], bbox[3]-bbox[1]

# ========== HEADER ==========
y = 50
draw.text((W//2, y), "CODING AI LEADERBOARD", font=f_title, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="mt")
y += 70
draw.text((W//2, y), "Weekly GitHub Star Growth  ·  Apr 9 – 15, 2026", font=f_subtitle, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mt")
y += 60

# ========== METRICS ==========
metrics = [
    ("+9,715", "Top Weekly Gain", "hermes-agent", ACCENT_BLUE),
    ("~48k", "Total Stars", "Top 20 combined", ACCENT_GREEN),
    ("10", "Repos 2k+", "Half the leaderboard", ACCENT_AMBER),
    ("5", "Claude Ecosystem", "Repos in top 20", ACCENT_PURPLE),
]

m_card_w = 230
m_card_h = 110
m_gap = 20
start_x = (W - (4*m_card_w + 3*m_gap)) // 2
for i, (val, label, ctx, color) in enumerate(metrics):
    x = start_x + i*(m_card_w + m_gap)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x+m_card_w, y+m_card_h), 12, SURFACE, BORDER)
    draw.text((x + m_card_w//2, y+18), val, font=f_metric_val, fill=color, anchor="mt")
    draw.text((x + m_card_w//2, y+62), label, font=f_metric_label, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="mt")
    draw.text((x + m_card_w//2, y+86), ctx, font=load_font(font_path, 14), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mt")

y += m_card_h + 40

# ========== SECTION: TOP 5 ==========
draw.text((60, y), "▎TOP 5 FASTEST-RISING REPOS", font=f_section_title, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
y += 50

top5 = [
    (1, "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent", "+9,715", "Agent Framework"),
    (2, "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "+4,917", "Skills / Education"),
    (3, "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman", "+4,407", "Developer Tool"),
    (4, "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace", "+3,524", "Memory / Agent"),
    (5, "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md", "+3,246", "AI Design"),
]

row_h = 56
for rank, trend, repo, stars, tag in top5:
    # row background
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (50, y, W-50, y+row_h), 10, SURFACE_LIGHT, BORDER)
    # rank
    draw.text((80, y+row_h//2), f"#{rank}", font=f_rank_num, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
    # trend
    trend_color = ACCENT_GREEN if trend=="▲" else (ACCENT_RED if trend=="▼" else TEXT_SECONDARY)
    draw.text((130, y+row_h//2), trend, font=f_trend, fill=trend_color, anchor="lm")
    # repo
    draw.text((175, y+row_h//2), repo, font=f_repo_name, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="lm")
    # tag pill
    tw, th = text_size(tag, f_tag)
    pill_w, pill_h = tw+20, th+10
    pill_x = W - 280 - pill_w
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (pill_x, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2, pill_x+pill_w, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2+pill_h), 8, SURFACE, BORDER)
    draw.text((pill_x+pill_w//2, y+row_h//2), tag, font=f_tag, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mm")
    # stars
    draw.text((W-80, y+row_h//2), stars, font=f_stars, fill=ACCENT_AMBER, anchor="rm")
    y += row_h + 10

y += 30

# ========== SECTION: FULL TOP 20 ==========
draw.text((60, y), "▎FULL WEEKLY TOP 20", font=f_section_title, fill=ACCENT_GREEN)
y += 45

# Table header
header_h = 36
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (50, y, W-50, y+header_h), 8, SURFACE, BORDER)
draw.text((80, y+header_h//2), "#", font=load_font(font_bold_path, 18), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
draw.text((130, y+header_h//2), "Trend", font=load_font(font_bold_path, 18), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
draw.text((210, y+header_h//2), "Repository", font=load_font(font_bold_path, 18), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
draw.text((W-150, y+header_h//2), "Weekly Stars", font=load_font(font_bold_path, 18), fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
y += header_h + 6

all20 = [
    (1, "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent", "+9,715", "Agent Framework"),
    (2, "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "+4,917", "Skills"),
    (3, "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman", "+4,407", "Dev Tool"),
    (4, "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace", "+3,524", "Memory"),
    (5, "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md", "+3,246", "Design"),
    (6, "▲", "microsoft/markitdown", "+3,048", "Utility"),
    (7, "▼", "safishamsi/graphify", "+2,763", "Design"),
    (8, "▲", "obra/superpowers", "+2,180", "Agent"),
    (9, "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "+2,151", "Claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code", "+1,978", "Claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem", "+1,828", "Claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops", "+1,788", "Career"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica", "+1,506", "Agent"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos", "+1,286", "Dev Tool"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code", "+1,285", "Claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw", "+1,268", "Claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM", "+1,266", "Model"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills", "+1,195", "Agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk", "+1,098", "Toolkit"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack", "+1,012", "New Entry"),
]

# Category color map
cat_colors = {
    "Agent Framework": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Agent": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Claude": ACCENT_PURPLE,
    "Design": ACCENT_AMBER,
    "Utility": ACCENT_GREEN,
    "New Entry": ACCENT_RED,
}

def get_cat_color(cat):
    return cat_colors.get(cat, TEXT_SECONDARY)

row_h = 38
for rank, trend, repo, stars, tag in all20:
    # alternating subtle bg
    bg = SURFACE if rank % 2 == 0 else BG
    draw.rectangle((50, y, W-50, y+row_h), fill=bg)
    # rank
    rank_color = ACCENT_AMBER if rank <= 3 else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw.text((80, y+row_h//2), str(rank), font=load_font(font_bold_path, 18), fill=rank_color, anchor="lm")
    # trend
    trend_color = ACCENT_GREEN if trend=="▲" else (ACCENT_RED if trend=="▼" else TEXT_SECONDARY)
    if trend == "N":
        trend_color = ACCENT_BLUE
    draw.text((130, y+row_h//2), trend, font=load_font(font_path, 18), fill=trend_color, anchor="lm")
    # repo
    draw.text((210, y+row_h//2), repo, font=load_font(font_path, 18), fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="lm")
    # tag pill
    tw, th = text_size(tag, f_tag)
    pill_w, pill_h = tw+14, th+8
    pill_x = W - 280 - pill_w
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (pill_x, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2, pill_x+pill_w, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2+pill_h), 6, SURFACE, BORDER)
    draw.text((pill_x+pill_w//2, y+row_h//2), tag, font=f_tag, fill=get_cat_color(tag), anchor="mm")
    # stars
    draw.text((W-80, y+row_h//2), stars, font=load_font(font_mono_path, 18), fill=ACCENT_AMBER, anchor="rm")
    y += row_h

y += 30

# ========== KEY TAKEAWAYS ==========
draw.text((60, y), "▎KEY TAKEAWAYS", font=f_section_title, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
y += 45

takeaways = [
    "1. Agent-first development is surging — hermes-agent's nearly 10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry.",
    "2. Claude Code's ecosystem is expanding fast — 25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product.",
    "3. Utility tools like markitdown show foundational open-source packages still attract strong interest.",
]

for t in takeaways:
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (50, y, W-50, y+50), 10, SURFACE_LIGHT, BORDER)
    draw.text((70, y+25), t, font=f_takeaway, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="lm")
    y += 62

y += 20

# ========== FOOTER ==========
draw.text((W//2, H-40), "Data sourced from star-history.com  ·  Week of Apr 9 – 15, 2026", font=f_footer, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mm")

# Save
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png")
print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")

ACCENT_PURPLE = "#a371f7"
ACCENT_RED = "#f85149"

# Font setup
font_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
font_bold_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
font_mono_path = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf"

def load_font(path, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

f_title = load_font(font_bold_path, 56)
f_subtitle = load_font(font_path, 26)
f_metric_val = load_font(font_bold_path, 42)
f_metric_label = load_font(font_path, 18)
f_metric_ctx = load_font(font_path, 14)
f_section_title = load_font(font_bold_path, 28)
f_rank_num = load_font(font_bold_path, 22)
f_repo_name = load_font(font_bold_path, 22)
f_stars = load_font(font_mono_path, 20)
f_trend = load_font(font_path, 20)
f_tag = load_font(font_path, 16)
f_takeaway = load_font(font_path, 20)
f_footer = load_font(font_path, 16)
f_table_header = load_font(font_bold_path, 18)
f_table_row = load_font(font_path, 18)
f_table_row_bold = load_font(font_bold_path, 18)
f_table_mono = load_font(font_mono_path, 18)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def text_size(text, font):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2]-bbox[0], bbox[3]-bbox[1]

# ========== HEADER ==========
y = 50
draw.text((W//2, y), "CODING AI LEADERBOARD", font=f_title, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="mt")
y += 70
draw.text((W//2, y), "Weekly GitHub Star Growth  ·  Apr 9 – 15, 2026", font=f_subtitle, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mt")
y += 60

# ========== METRICS ==========
metrics = [
    ("+9,715", "Top Weekly Gain", "hermes-agent", ACCENT_BLUE),
    ("~48k", "Total Stars", "Top 20 combined", ACCENT_GREEN),
    ("10", "Repos 2k+", "Half the leaderboard", ACCENT_AMBER),
    ("5", "Claude Ecosystem", "Repos in top 20", ACCENT_PURPLE),
]

m_card_w = 230
m_card_h = 110
m_gap = 20
start_x = (W - (4*m_card_w + 3*m_gap)) // 2
for i, (val, label, ctx, color) in enumerate(metrics):
    x = start_x + i*(m_card_w + m_gap)
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (x, y, x+m_card_w, y+m_card_h), 12, SURFACE, BORDER)
    draw.text((x + m_card_w//2, y+18), val, font=f_metric_val, fill=color, anchor="mt")
    draw.text((x + m_card_w//2, y+62), label, font=f_metric_label, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="mt")
    draw.text((x + m_card_w//2, y+86), ctx, font=f_metric_ctx, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mt")

y += m_card_h + 40

# ========== SECTION: TOP 5 ==========
draw.text((60, y), "▎TOP 5 FASTEST-RISING REPOS", font=f_section_title, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
y += 50

top5 = [
    (1, "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent", "+9,715", "Agent Framework"),
    (2, "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "+4,917", "Skills / Education"),
    (3, "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman", "+4,407", "Developer Tool"),
    (4, "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace", "+3,524", "Memory / Agent"),
    (5, "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md", "+3,246", "AI Design"),
]

row_h = 56
for rank, trend, repo, stars, tag in top5:
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (50, y, W-50, y+row_h), 10, SURFACE_LIGHT, BORDER)
    draw.text((80, y+row_h//2), f"#{rank}", font=f_rank_num, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
    trend_color = ACCENT_GREEN if trend=="▲" else (ACCENT_RED if trend=="▼" else TEXT_SECONDARY)
    draw.text((130, y+row_h//2), trend, font=f_trend, fill=trend_color, anchor="lm")
    draw.text((175, y+row_h//2), repo, font=f_repo_name, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="lm")
    tw, th = text_size(tag, f_tag)
    pill_w, pill_h = tw+20, th+10
    pill_x = W - 280 - pill_w
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (pill_x, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2, pill_x+pill_w, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2+pill_h), 8, SURFACE, BORDER)
    draw.text((pill_x+pill_w//2, y+row_h//2), tag, font=f_tag, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mm")
    draw.text((W-80, y+row_h//2), stars, font=f_stars, fill=ACCENT_AMBER, anchor="rm")
    y += row_h + 10

y += 30

# ========== SECTION: FULL TOP 20 ==========
draw.text((60, y), "▎FULL WEEKLY TOP 20", font=f_section_title, fill=ACCENT_GREEN)
y += 45

# Table header
header_h = 36
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (50, y, W-50, y+header_h), 8, SURFACE, BORDER)
draw.text((80, y+header_h//2), "#", font=f_table_header, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
draw.text((130, y+header_h//2), "Trend", font=f_table_header, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
draw.text((210, y+header_h//2), "Repository", font=f_table_header, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
draw.text((W-150, y+header_h//2), "Weekly Stars", font=f_table_header, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="lm")
y += header_h + 6

all20 = [
    (1, "—", "NousResearch/hermes-agent", "+9,715", "Agent Framework"),
    (2, "▲", "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "+4,917", "Skills"),
    (3, "—", "JuliusBrussee/caveman", "+4,407", "Dev Tool"),
    (4, "▼", "MemPalace/mempalace", "+3,524", "Memory"),
    (5, "—", "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md", "+3,246", "Design"),
    (6, "▲", "microsoft/markitdown", "+3,048", "Utility"),
    (7, "▼", "safishamsi/graphify", "+2,763", "Design"),
    (8, "▲", "obra/superpowers", "+2,180", "Agent"),
    (9, "▲", "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "+2,151", "Claude"),
    (10, "—", "affaan-m/everything-claude-code", "+1,978", "Claude"),
    (11, "▲", "thedotmack/claude-mem", "+1,828", "Claude"),
    (12, "▼", "santifer/career-ops", "+1,788", "Career"),
    (13, "▲", "multica-ai/multica", "+1,506", "Agent"),
    (14, "▲", "shiyu-coder/Kronos", "+1,286", "Dev Tool"),
    (15, "▼", "ultraworkers/claw-code", "+1,285", "Claude"),
    (16, "▼", "openclaw/openclaw", "+1,268", "Claude"),
    (17, "▼", "OpenBMB/VoxCPM", "+1,266", "Model"),
    (18, "▼", "addyosmani/agent-skills", "+1,195", "Agent"),
    (19, "—", "rtk-ai/rtk", "+1,098", "Toolkit"),
    (20, "N", "garrytan/gstack", "+1,012", "New Entry"),
]

cat_colors = {
    "Agent Framework": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Agent": ACCENT_BLUE,
    "Claude": ACCENT_PURPLE,
    "Design": ACCENT_AMBER,
    "Utility": ACCENT_GREEN,
    "New Entry": ACCENT_RED,
}

def get_cat_color(cat):
    return cat_colors.get(cat, TEXT_SECONDARY)

row_h = 38
for rank, trend, repo, stars, tag in all20:
    bg = SURFACE if rank % 2 == 0 else BG
    draw.rectangle((50, y, W-50, y+row_h), fill=bg)
    rank_color = ACCENT_AMBER if rank <= 3 else TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw.text((80, y+row_h//2), str(rank), font=f_table_row_bold, fill=rank_color, anchor="lm")
    trend_color = ACCENT_GREEN if trend=="▲" else (ACCENT_RED if trend=="▼" else TEXT_SECONDARY)
    if trend == "N":
        trend_color = ACCENT_BLUE
    draw.text((130, y+row_h//2), trend, font=f_table_row, fill=trend_color, anchor="lm")
    draw.text((210, y+row_h//2), repo, font=f_table_row, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="lm")
    tw, th = text_size(tag, f_tag)
    pill_w, pill_h = tw+14, th+8
    pill_x = W - 280 - pill_w
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (pill_x, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2, pill_x+pill_w, y+(row_h-pill_h)//2+pill_h), 6, SURFACE, BORDER)
    draw.text((pill_x+pill_w//2, y+row_h//2), tag, font=f_tag, fill=get_cat_color(tag), anchor="mm")
    draw.text((W-80, y+row_h//2), stars, font=f_table_mono, fill=ACCENT_AMBER, anchor="rm")
    y += row_h

y += 30

# ========== KEY TAKEAWAYS ==========
draw.text((60, y), "▎KEY TAKEAWAYS", font=f_section_title, fill=ACCENT_AMBER)
y += 45

takeaways = [
    "1. Agent-first development is surging — hermes-agent's nearly 10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry.",
    "2. Claude Code's ecosystem is expanding fast — 25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product.",
    "3. Utility tools like markitdown show foundational open-source packages still attract strong interest.",
]

for t in takeaways:
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (50, y, W-50, y+50), 10, SURFACE_LIGHT, BORDER)
    draw.text((70, y+25), t, font=f_takeaway, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, anchor="lm")
    y += 62

y += 20

# ========== FOOTER ==========
draw.text((W//2, H-40), "Data sourced from star-history.com  ·  Week of Apr 9 – 15, 2026", font=f_footer, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, anchor="mm")

# Save
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png")
print("Saved /app/output/final_poster.png")
